4372b717ece66dec4580740d1e43b840fe943e36.summary: Flashpoint reports a new FIN7-linked attack panel called Astra, plus SQLRat and DNSbot malware, in campaigns it dates to May to July 2018, possibly back to January 2018. Lures were phishing emails with malicious documents. The samples use scheduled tasks for persistence and DNS-based command channels. The report cites DoJ indictments for the Combi Security front company and for FIN7 theft of more than 15 million payment card records from US businesses. The FIN7 link is the report's own linking, not a confirmed finding.
